phrases.phrase: Ticket hooks
Active
An inactive hook opens nothing, and a caller cannot tell it from a hook that does not exist.
Add ticket hook
Every ticket this hook opens goes in this category. Only categories that allow tickets to be opened are listed.
The requested ticket category could not be found.
{category} requires a prefix but has no default one. Set a default prefix on the category, or choose another category.
Done
The requested ticket hook could not be found.
Hook URL
Paste this as the Discord webhook URL in the caller. Every post to it opens one ticket.
Hook URL for a bearer header
A caller that can send an Authorization: Bearer header may post here with the token in the header instead, which keeps it out of access logs.
Last ticket
Last used
Up to 150 characters. A post that carries no title of its own opens a ticket with this name as its title.
No ticket hooks have been written yet.
Opener user ID {id} names no user. Correct the option under Setup > Options > Ticket Webhook before saving a hook.
{opener} may not open a ticket in {category}: {reason}
Replace token
Replace the token for '{name}'? The current token stops working at once, and the new one is shown once.
Set '{name}' active or inactive
the opener has no permission to create tickets there
Ticket hook
Ticket hooks
Token
The token is stored only as a hash and cannot be shown again. Use Replace token to issue a new one.
The token is generated when you save and shown once, with the URL to paste into the caller.
Copy the URL now. The token is stored only as a hash and will not be shown again.
Opener user ID
The XenForo user every hook ticket is opened as.
Ticket Webhook
Opens an NF/Tickets ticket when a remote tool posts to a hook.
